picture.alt: A sunny school campus: three young people walk side by side past a modern building with big glass walls. Through the glass you can see a basketball hoop and rows of blue exercise machines: it is a gym. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair and round glasses wears a light-blue face mask, a white short-sleeved shirt with a purple sweater vest, and green trousers; a white cloth bag hangs from her shoulder and she holds one hand up near her chest. In the middle, a girl with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings wears a blue jacket over an orange top and white trousers, with a black bag on her shoulder; she smiles and looks at the girl in the mask next to her. On the right, a young man with black hair wears an open green shirt over a red striped T-shirt and dark trousers; a blue sports bag hangs from his shoulder, and he smiles and holds out his other hand toward the gym. Trees with yellow-green leaves and a blue sky are behind them.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 穿藍色外套的女生在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 穿蓝色外套的女生在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Chuān lánsè wàitào de nǚshēng zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the girl in the blue jacket doing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她拿著一個白色的袋子。
choices.simplified: 她拿着一个白色的袋子。
choices.pinyin: Tā ná zhe yí ge báisè de dàizi.
choices.english: She is holding a white bag.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiào zhe kàn pángbiān de nǚshēng.
choices.english: She is smiling at the girl next to her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她戴著眼鏡跟朋友說話。
choices.simplified: 她戴着眼镜跟朋友说话。
choices.pinyin: Tā dài zhe yǎnjìng gēn péngyǒu shuōhuà.
choices.english: She is wearing glasses and talking with a friend.

questions.why: The girl in the blue jacket smiles and looks at the girl next to her, the one in the mask. The glasses and the white cloth bag belong to that girl; the girl in the blue jacket carries a black bag.

picture.alt: A sunny day at a school: three young people run side by side on a red running track. Inside the track is a green grass field with a soccer goal; school buildings and trees stand in the back under a blue sky with a few clouds. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair and round glasses wears a white T-shirt and green trousers with a white stripe. In the middle, a young man with black hair wears a red striped T-shirt and black shorts. On the right, a girl with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings wears a blue jacket over an orange top and dark leggings. All three wear white running shoes, smile and run easily with their arms bent; nobody is on the grass or playing ball.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這三個人在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这三个人在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè sān ge rén zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What are these three people doing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: They are working out in a gym.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zài cǎodì shàng tī zúqiú.
choices.english: They are playing soccer on the grass.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: They are jogging on the sports field.

questions.why: The three of them jog together on the school's red running track, outdoors. The grass and the soccer goal are behind them, but nobody is playing ball, and they are not in a gym.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳已經咳嗽一個星期了，到底要不要去看病？
lines.simplified: 你已经咳嗽一个星期了，到底要不要去看病？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yǐjīng késòu yí ge xīngqí le, dàodǐ yào bú yào qù kànbìng?
lines.english: You've been coughing for a week already. Are you going to see a doctor or not?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我想先去藥局買藥吃吃看，也許過兩天就好了。
lines.simplified: 我想先去药局买药吃吃看，也许过两天就好了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān qù yàojú mǎi yào chīchī kàn, yěxǔ guò liǎng tiān jiù hǎo le.
lines.english: I'd like to get some medicine at the drugstore first and see. Maybe it'll be better in a couple of days.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳上個星期也是這麼說的。今天下午我陪妳去吧。
lines.simplified: 你上个星期也是这么说的。今天下午我陪你去吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge xīngqí yě shì zhème shuō de. Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ péi nǐ qù ba.
lines.english: You said the same thing last week. I'll go with you this afternoon.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，那我先去把報告交了，三點在學校門口等你。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那我先去把报告交了，三点在学校门口等你。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà wǒ xiān qù bǎ bàogào jiāo le, sān diǎn zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
lines.english: All right. Then I'll hand in my report first and wait for you at the school gate at three.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的的意思是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的的意思是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de de yìsi shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的可以先買藥吃吃看
choices.simplified: 女的可以先买药吃吃看
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de kěyǐ xiān mǎi yào chīchī kàn.
choices.english: She can try some medicine first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的今天就應該去看病
choices.simplified: 女的今天就应该去看病
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de jīntiān jiù yīnggāi qù kànbìng.
choices.english: She should see a doctor today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhǎo zài jiā duō xiūxí.
choices.english: She had better rest at home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de yīnggāi xiān qù jiāo bàogào.
choices.english: She should hand in her report first.

questions.why: 到底要不要去看病？ presses her for a real answer, and 妳上個星期也是這麼說的 shows he won't accept more waiting: he wants her to see a doctor today (今天下午我陪妳去). Trying medicine first and handing in the report are her own ideas, and nobody suggests staying home to rest.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 晚上想吃什麼？學校旁邊有一家新的漢堡店，要不要去吃吃看？還是我們去吃牛肉麵？
lines.simplified: 晚上想吃什么？学校旁边有一家新的汉堡店，要不要去吃吃看？还是我们去吃牛肉面？
lines.pinyin: Wǎnshàng xiǎng chī shénme? Xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā xīn de hànbǎo diàn, yào bú yào qù chīchī kàn? Háishì wǒmen qù chī niúròu miàn?
lines.english: What do you want for dinner? There's a new burger place next to the school. Shall we try it? Or shall we have beef noodles?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 都可以，你決定吧。
lines.simplified: 都可以，你决定吧。
lines.pinyin: Dōu kěyǐ, nǐ juédìng ba.
lines.english: Either's fine. You decide.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳每次都說都可以。妳到底想吃什麼？
lines.simplified: 你每次都说都可以。你到底想吃什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ měi cì dōu shuō dōu kěyǐ. Nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng chī shénme?
lines.english: You always say "either's fine". What do you actually want to eat?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那吃牛肉麵吧。我最近胖了，不想吃太油的東西。
lines.simplified: 那吃牛肉面吧。我最近胖了，不想吃太油的东西。
lines.pinyin: Nà chī niúròu miàn ba. Wǒ zuìjìn pàng le, bù xiǎng chī tài yóu de dōngxi.
lines.english: Then beef noodles. I've put on weight lately, and I don't want anything too oily.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得女的怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得女的怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde nǚ de zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of the woman?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā měi cì dōu xiǎng qù xīn de diàn.
choices.english: She always wants to try new places.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuān chī niúròu miàn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā lǎoshì chī de tài duō.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā lǎoshì bù shuō xiǎng chī shénme.
choices.english: She never says what she wants to eat.

questions.why: 妳每次都說都可以。妳到底想吃什麼？: 每次 and 到底 show he is tired of her never saying what she wants. She picks the beef noodles herself, putting on weight is her own remark (he never says she eats too much), and the new burger place was his idea.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這家小吃店怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 这家小吃店怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎochī diàn zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: How's this snack shop?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 滷肉飯很好吃，肉也給得很多，可是湯鹹死了，我喝了一點就不敢再喝了。
lines.simplified: 卤肉饭很好吃，肉也给得很多，可是汤咸死了，我喝了一点就不敢再喝了。
lines.pinyin: Lǔròufàn hěn hǎochī, ròu yě gěi de hěn duō, kěshì tāng xián sǐ le, wǒ hē le yìdiǎn jiù bù gǎn zài hē le.
lines.english: The braised pork rice is good and they give you lots of meat, but the soup is terribly salty. After a little I didn't dare drink any more.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 吃太鹹對身體不好。下次我們去對面那家吧，那家的菜，油和鹽都放得比較少。
lines.simplified: 吃太咸对身体不好。下次我们去对面那家吧，那家的菜，油和盐都放得比较少。
lines.pinyin: Chī tài xián duì shēntǐ bù hǎo. Xià cì wǒmen qù duìmiàn nà jiā ba, nà jiā de cài, yóu hé yán dōu fàng de bǐjiào shǎo.
lines.english: Eating very salty food isn't good for you. Next time let's go to the place across the street; they use less oil and salt.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這家小吃店怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这家小吃店怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè jiā xiǎochī diàn zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of this snack shop?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāng fàng de yán tài duō.
choices.english: The soup has too much salt.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: There is too little meat on the rice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Cài fàng de yóu tài duō.
choices.english: The food has too much oil.

questions.why: 湯鹹死了 means the soup was far too salty, so he stopped drinking it. He says the rice is good and the meat generous, less oil and salt is what she says about the shop across the street, and he never mentions prices.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼一直吃餅乾？
lines.simplified: 你怎么一直吃饼干？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yìzhí chī bǐnggān?
lines.english: Why do you keep eating cookies?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我餓死了！早上起晚了，來不及吃早飯，中午又忙得沒時間吃。
lines.simplified: 我饿死了！早上起晚了，来不及吃早饭，中午又忙得没时间吃。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ è sǐ le! Zǎoshàng qǐ wǎn le, láibùjí chī zǎofàn, zhōngwǔ yòu máng de méi shíjiān chī.
lines.english: I'm starving! I got up late this morning and had no time for breakfast, and at noon I was too busy to eat.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那也別吃那麼多，等一下就要吃晚飯了。先喝杯開水吧。
lines.simplified: 那也别吃那么多，等一下就要吃晚饭了。先喝杯开水吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà yě bié chī nàme duō, děng yíxià jiù yào chī wǎnfàn le. Xiān hē bēi kāishuǐ ba.
lines.english: Still, don't eat so many. We're having dinner soon. Have a glass of water first.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，可是我還要再吃一塊。
lines.simplified: 好吧，可是我还要再吃一块。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, kěshì wǒ hái yào zài chī yí kuài.
lines.english: All right, but I'm having one more.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的現在怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的现在怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How is the man now?

questions.why: 餓死了 says he is extremely hungry (死了 is even stronger than 得不得了): no breakfast, and no time to eat at noon. He was busy at noon, not now; the water is her idea, and he never says he is thirsty or tired.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想趁著春假去花蓮玩兩天，可是火車票已經賣光了。
lines.simplified: 我想趁着春假去花莲玩两天，可是火车票已经卖光了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chèn zhe chūnjià qù Huālián wán liǎng tiān, kěshì huǒchē piào yǐjīng mài guāng le.
lines.english: I want to use spring break to spend two days in Hualien, but the train tickets are sold out.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那坐巴士呢？
lines.simplified: 那坐巴士呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà zuò bāshì ne?
lines.english: What about the bus?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 巴士要坐六個小時，太累了。
lines.simplified: 巴士要坐六个小时，太累了。
lines.pinyin: Bāshì yào zuò liù ge xiǎoshí, tài lèi le.
lines.english: The bus takes six hours. Too tiring.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我哥哥那天要開車去花蓮，你可以坐他的車啊。
lines.simplified: 我哥哥那天要开车去花莲，你可以坐他的车啊。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēge nà tiān yào kāichē qù Huālián, nǐ kěyǐ zuò tā de chē a.
lines.english: My brother is driving to Hualien that day. You could ride with him.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 謝謝，可是他要在那裡住一個星期。機票只要兩千多塊，我還是坐飛機吧。
lines.simplified: 谢谢，可是他要在那里住一个星期。机票只要两千多块，我还是坐飞机吧。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, kěshì tā yào zài nàlǐ zhù yí ge xīngqí. Jīpiào zhǐ yào liǎngqiān duō kuài, wǒ háishì zuò fēijī ba.
lines.english: Thanks, but he's staying there a week. A plane ticket is only a bit over two thousand. I'll fly.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼去花蓮？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么去花莲？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme qù Huālián?
prompt.english: How does the man plan to get to Hualien?

questions.why: The train tickets are sold out (賣光了), the bus takes too long, and her brother stays a week while he only wants two days, so he flies (我還是坐飛機吧).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個星期五晚上我們去KTV唱歌，好不好？
lines.simplified: 这个星期五晚上我们去KTV唱歌，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng wǒmen qù KTV chànggē, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Shall we go and sing at a KTV this Friday evening?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我星期五還有考試，等我考完了就去。
lines.simplified: 我星期五还有考试，等我考完了就去。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xīngqíwǔ hái yǒu kǎoshì, děng wǒ kǎo wán le jiù qù.
lines.english: I still have an exam on Friday. Once I've finished my exams, I'll go.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你哪天考完？
lines.simplified: 你哪天考完？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ nǎ tiān kǎo wán?
lines.english: Which day do you finish?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下個星期三下午。考完要慶祝一下，我們那天晚上就去吧！
lines.simplified: 下个星期三下午。考完要庆祝一下，我们那天晚上就去吧！
lines.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqísān xiàwǔ. Kǎo wán yào qìngzhù yíxià, wǒmen nà tiān wǎnshàng jiù qù ba!
lines.english: Next Wednesday afternoon. We should celebrate when it's over, so let's go that evening!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，那我先上網訂位。
lines.simplified: 好啊，那我先上网订位。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, nà wǒ xiān shàngwǎng dìngwèi.
lines.english: OK, then I'll book online.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們打算什麼時候去KTV唱歌？
prompt.simplified: 他们打算什么时候去KTV唱歌？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen dǎsuàn shénme shíhòu qù KTV chànggē?
prompt.english: When do they plan to go and sing at a KTV?

questions.why: 等我考完了就去: his last exam is next Wednesday afternoon, and he wants to celebrate straight after, so they go that evening (那天晚上). Wednesday morning he still has exams, and Thursday is never mentioned.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我下個月要跟同學去爬山，可是我的體力太差了。這個週末你陪我去運動，好不好？
lines.simplified: 我下个月要跟同学去爬山，可是我的体力太差了。这个周末你陪我去运动，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè yào gēn tóngxué qù páshān, kěshì wǒ de tǐlì tài chà le. Zhège zhōumò nǐ péi wǒ qù yùndòng, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Next month I'm going hiking with classmates, but my stamina is poor. Will you come and exercise with me this weekend?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊！天氣好的話，我們去河邊騎腳踏車；下雨的話，就去游泳或是去健身房。
lines.simplified: 好啊！天气好的话，我们去河边骑脚踏车；下雨的话，就去游泳或是去健身房。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Tiānqì hǎo dehuà, wǒmen qù hébiān qí jiǎotàchē; xiàyǔ dehuà, jiù qù yóuyǒng huòshì qù jiànshēnfáng.
lines.english: Sure! If the weather's good, we'll ride bikes by the river; if it rains, we'll go swimming or to the gym.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說這個週末會下大雨。下雨天在家休息不好嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说这个周末会下大雨。下雨天在家休息不好吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhège zhōumò huì xià dàyǔ. Xiàyǔ tiān zài jiā xiūxí bù hǎo ma?
lines.english: I heard it's going to pour this weekend. Isn't resting at home on a rainy day fine?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當然不好！我以前也不愛運動，是醫生要我多運動，我才開始的，現在一個星期不運動就不舒服。
lines.simplified: 当然不好！我以前也不爱运动，是医生要我多运动，我才开始的，现在一个星期不运动就不舒服。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán bù hǎo! Wǒ yǐqián yě bú ài yùndòng, shì yīshēng yào wǒ duō yùndòng, wǒ cái kāishǐ de, xiànzài yí ge xīngqí bú yùndòng jiù bù shūfu.
lines.english: Of course not! I didn't like exercise either. I only started because my doctor told me to, and now if I go a week without it I feel bad.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，不過我不會游泳。
lines.simplified: 好吧，不过我不会游泳。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, búguò wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng.
lines.english: All right, but I can't swim.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那就這樣決定了。
lines.simplified: 那就这样决定了。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù zhèyàng juédìng le.
lines.english: Then it's settled.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們這個週末最可能做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 他们这个周末最可能做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zhège zhōumò zuì kěnéng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will they most likely do this weekend?

questions.why: 下雨的話 they swim or go to the gym; heavy rain is coming, and she can't swim, so the gym is left. The bike ride is the fine-weather plan, and resting at home is her idea, which he turns down.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼想運動？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么想运动？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme xiǎng yùndòng?
prompt.english: Why does the woman want to exercise?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Her doctor told her to exercise more.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她想讓自己的體力好一點
choices.simplified: 她想让自己的体力好一点
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng ràng zìjǐ de tǐlì hǎo yìdiǎn.
choices.english: She wants to build up her stamina.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng ràng zìjǐ shòu yìdiǎn.
choices.english: She wants to lose a little weight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng duō jiāo yìxiē péngyǒu.
choices.english: She wants to make more friends.

questions.why: 我下個月要跟同學去爬山，可是我的體力太差了: she wants more stamina before next month's hike. The doctor is the man's story, and she never mentions her weight or making friends.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想三個月減五公斤。晚上只喝開水的話，是不是會瘦得比較快？
lines.simplified: 我想三个月减五公斤。晚上只喝开水的话，是不是会瘦得比较快？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng sān ge yuè jiǎn wǔ gōngjīn. Wǎnshàng zhǐ hē kāishuǐ dehuà, shì bú shì huì shòu de bǐjiào kuài?
lines.english: I want to lose five kilos in three months. If I only drink water in the evening, will I lose weight faster?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這樣不好。晚上只喝水，半夜一定會餓，最後還是會跑去便利商店買餅乾。
lines.simplified: 这样不好。晚上只喝水，半夜一定会饿，最后还是会跑去便利商店买饼干。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng bù hǎo. Wǎnshàng zhǐ hē shuǐ, bànyè yídìng huì è, zuìhòu háishì huì pǎo qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi bǐnggān.
lines.english: That's not good. If you only drink water in the evening, you'll be hungry at midnight and end up running to the convenience store for cookies.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我晚上吃完飯去散步，好不好？
lines.simplified: 那我晚上吃完饭去散步，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ wǎnshàng chī wán fàn qù sànbù, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Then how about a walk after dinner?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 飯後散步走得太慢，沒什麼用。你每天要走得快一點，走半個小時，比去健身房跑步容易做到。
lines.simplified: 饭后散步走得太慢，没什么用。你每天要走得快一点，走半个小时，比去健身房跑步容易做到。
lines.pinyin: Fàn hòu sànbù zǒu de tài màn, méi shénme yòng. Nǐ měi tiān yào zǒu de kuài yìdiǎn, zǒu bàn ge xiǎoshí, bǐ qù jiànshēnfáng pǎobù róngyì zuò dào.
lines.english: A walk after dinner is too slow to do much good. You need to walk fast for half an hour every day. That's easier to keep up than running at the gym.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽起來不難，我明天就開始。
lines.simplified: 听起来不难，我明天就开始。
lines.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái bù nán, wǒ míngtiān jiù kāishǐ.
lines.english: Sounds doable. I'll start tomorrow.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得晚上只喝開水會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得晚上只喝开水会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde wǎnshàng zhǐ hē kāishuǐ huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think will happen if he only drinks water in the evening?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Sān ge yuè néng shòu wǔ gōngjīn.
choices.english: He can lose five kilos in three months.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He will want to eat at midnight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎnshàng huì shuì de bǐjiào hǎo.
choices.english: He will sleep better at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He will have no energy in the morning.

questions.why: She answers his plan to drink only water in the evening: 半夜一定會餓，最後還是會…買餅乾, so he would be hungry at night and end up eating anyway. Five kilos in three months is only his hope, and she says nothing about sleep or energy in the morning.

focus.en: will surely be hungry at midnight

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的要男的每天做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的要男的每天做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de yào nán de měi tiān zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman want the man to do every day?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Stroll for an hour after dinner.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Run at the gym every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān kuài zǒu bàn ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: Walk fast for half an hour every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Jog for twenty minutes every day.

questions.why: 你每天要走得快一點，走半個小時: a brisk half-hour walk every day. She says a walk after dinner is too slow to do any good, the gym run is only what she compares it with, and she never says to jog.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 李先生，您好，我是健身房的教練。您昨天說想減三公斤，我幫您想了一個計畫。
lines.simplified: 李先生，您好，我是健身房的教练。您昨天说想减三公斤，我帮您想了一个计划。
lines.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng, nín hǎo, wǒ shì jiànshēnfáng de jiàoliàn. Nín zuótiān shuō xiǎng jiǎn sān gōngjīn, wǒ bāng nín xiǎng le yí ge jìhuà.
lines.english: Hello, Mr. Li, this is your coach at the gym. Yesterday you said you'd like to lose three kilos, so I've worked out a plan for you.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 很多人一開始就每天都來，可是對剛開始健身的人來說，一個星期來三次就夠了，每次一個小時。
lines.simplified: 很多人一开始就每天都来，可是对刚开始健身的人来说，一个星期来三次就够了，每次一个小时。
lines.pinyin: Hěn duō rén yìkāishǐ jiù měi tiān dōu lái, kěshì duì gāng kāishǐ jiànshēn de rén lái shuō, yí ge xīngqí lái sān cì jiù gòu le, měi cì yí ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Many people come every day right from the start, but for someone just starting to work out, three times a week is enough, an hour each time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還有，上下班的時候別坐公車了，騎腳踏車去，對減體重也很有幫助。
lines.simplified: 还有，上下班的时候别坐公车了，骑脚踏车去，对减体重也很有帮助。
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu, shàngxiàbān de shíhòu bié zuò gōngchē le, qí jiǎotàchē qù, duì jiǎn tǐzhòng yě hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
lines.english: Also, stop taking the bus to and from work. Riding a bike there helps with losing weight too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 您的第一堂課是星期三晚上七點，請穿運動服來。
lines.simplified: 您的第一堂课是星期三晚上七点，请穿运动服来。
lines.pinyin: Nín de dì yī táng kè shì xīngqísān wǎnshàng qī diǎn, qǐng chuān yùndòngfú lái.
lines.english: Your first session is on Wednesday at seven in the evening. Please come in sportswear.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 教練覺得李先生一個星期來幾次就夠了？
prompt.simplified: 教练觉得李先生一个星期来几次就够了？
prompt.pinyin: Jiàoliàn juéde Lǐ xiānshēng yí ge xīngqí lái jǐ cì jiù gòu le?
prompt.english: How many times a week does the coach think is enough for Mr. Li?

questions.why: 對剛開始健身的人來說，一個星期來三次就夠了: for a beginner like him, three times a week. Coming every day (seven times) is what many people do (很多人一開始就每天都來), and one is the number of hours per session.

focus.en: for …; as far as … is concerned

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 教練說，除了來健身房，做什麼對減體重也有幫助？
prompt.simplified: 教练说，除了来健身房，做什么对减体重也有帮助？
prompt.pinyin: Jiàoliàn shuō, chúle lái jiànshēnfáng, zuò shénme duì jiǎn tǐzhòng yě yǒu bāngzhù?
prompt.english: Besides coming to the gym, what does the coach say also helps with losing weight?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Taking the bus to and from work.

questions.why: 上下班的時候別坐公車了，騎腳踏車去，對減體重也很有幫助: cycling to work instead of taking the bus. She never mentions walking to work or drinking less cola.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大家好，我是你們這學期的體育老師。我們每個星期有兩堂體育課，星期二在操場跑步，星期四打籃球。
lines.simplified: 大家好，我是你们这学期的体育老师。我们每个星期有两堂体育课，星期二在操场跑步，星期四打篮球。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì nǐmen zhè xuéqí de tǐyù lǎoshī. Wǒmen měi ge xīngqí yǒu liǎng táng tǐyù kè, xīngqí'èr zài cāochǎng pǎobù, xīngqísì dǎ lánqiú.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. I'm your PE teacher this semester. We have two PE classes a week: running on the sports field on Tuesdays and basketball on Thursdays.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對很多同學來說，跑步是最累的，所以一開始我們只跑八百公尺，以後再慢慢增加。
lines.simplified: 对很多同学来说，跑步是最累的，所以一开始我们只跑八百公尺，以后再慢慢增加。
lines.pinyin: Duì hěn duō tóngxué lái shuō, pǎobù shì zuì lèi de, suǒyǐ yìkāishǐ wǒmen zhǐ pǎo bābǎi gōngchǐ, yǐhòu zài mànmàn zēngjiā.
lines.english: For many of you, running is the most tiring, so at first we'll only run 800 meters and slowly add more later.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我知道大家都覺得打籃球比較好玩，可是跑步對體力比較有幫助，所以星期二的課也一定要來。
lines.simplified: 我知道大家都觉得打篮球比较好玩，可是跑步对体力比较有帮助，所以星期二的课也一定要来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào dàjiā dōu juéde dǎ lánqiú bǐjiào hǎowán, kěshì pǎobù duì tǐlì bǐjiào yǒu bāngzhù, suǒyǐ xīngqí'èr de kè yě yídìng yào lái.
lines.english: I know you all find basketball more fun, but running does more for your stamina, so you must come to Tuesday's class too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有，上課的時候，請穿運動服，別穿牛仔褲。
lines.simplified: 还有，上课的时候，请穿运动服，别穿牛仔裤。
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu, shàngkè de shíhòu, qǐng chuān yùndòngfú, bié chuān niúzǎikù.
lines.english: And in class, please wear sportswear, not jeans.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老師為什麼一開始只讓學生跑八百公尺？
prompt.simplified: 老师为什么一开始只让学生跑八百公尺？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèishénme yìkāishǐ zhǐ ràng xuéshēng pǎo bābǎi gōngchǐ?
prompt.english: Why does the teacher have the students run only 800 meters at first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 很多學生覺得跑步很累
choices.simplified: 很多学生觉得跑步很累
choices.pinyin: Hěn duō xuéshēng juéde pǎobù hěn lèi.
choices.english: Many students find running very tiring.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Cāochǎng shàng de rén tài duō le.
choices.english: The sports field is too crowded.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn duō xuéshēng méi chuān yùndòngfú.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yì táng kè de shíjiān bú gòu cháng.
choices.english: A class is not long enough.

questions.why: 對很多同學來說，跑步是最累的，所以……只跑八百公尺: because many students find running the hardest. He says nothing about crowds or how long a class is, and sportswear is simply a rule for every class.

focus.en: for …; as far as … is concerned

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老師為什麼說星期二的課也一定要來？
prompt.simplified: 老师为什么说星期二的课也一定要来？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèishénme shuō xīngqí'èr de kè yě yídìng yào lái?
prompt.english: Why does the teacher say students must come to Tuesday's class too?

choices.speaker: N

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Basketball is more fun than running.

questions.why: 跑步對體力比較有幫助，所以星期二的課也一定要來: Tuesday is the running class, and running does more for their stamina. Basketball being more fun is the students' view, no test is mentioned, and running is the class they find most tiring, not easier.

passage.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ hěn shǎo yùndòng, juéde pǎobù lèi sǐ le. Shàng ge yuè yīshēng shuō wǒ tài pàng le, jiànyì wǒ měi tiān qù cāochǎng mànpǎo. Yìkāishǐ wǒ pǎo shí fēnzhōng jiù xiǎng xiūxí, kěshì yuè pǎo yuè qīngsōng, xiànzài yǐjīng néng pǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí le. Mànpǎo búdàn ràng wǒ shòu le liǎng gōngjīn, érqiě ràng wǒ wǎnshàng shuì de bǐjiào hǎo. Yǐqián wǒ shàngkè lǎoshì dǎ kēshuì, xiànzài bǐjiào yǒu jīngshén le. Wǒ juéde yùndòng duì niànshū yě hěn yǒu hǎochù, suǒyǐ xiànzài chángcháng qǐng tóngxué gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù pǎo.
passage.english: I used to exercise very little and thought running was terribly tiring. Last month my doctor said I was too heavy and suggested I jog on the sports field every day. At first I wanted to rest after ten minutes, but the more I ran, the easier it got, and now I can run for half an hour. Jogging has not only helped me lose two kilos but also helped me sleep better at night. I used to doze off in class all the time; now I have more energy. I think exercise is good for studying too, so now I often ask classmates to come running with me.

questions.why: 醫生……建議我每天去操場慢跑: 建議 + person + action is the doctor's advice. 繼續, 改善 and 恢復 can't be followed by 我 + something to do.
越跑越輕鬆: the more the writer runs, the easier it gets. 越 … 越 come as a pair, so 更, 還 and 也 can't answer the first 越.
不但……，而且……: 而且 adds the second, bigger gain (better sleep). 所以, 可是 and 然後 don't pair with 不但.
以前我上課老是打瞌睡: the writer always used to doze off in class. 從小 would need 就, 到底 belongs in a question, and 來不及打瞌睡 makes no sense.
運動對念書很有好處: exercise is good for studying (對……有好處). 運動 can't 有興趣 or 有精神 for something, and 有情況 makes no sense here.

passage.simplified: 我家楼下有一位老先生，今年七十岁了。以前他{1}在家看电视，很少出门。去年他女儿建议他多活动，他就开始每天早上去公园散步。{2}他来说，一开始每天早上出门是很辛苦的事，可是他越走{3}有精神，现在每天能走一个小时。他还在公园交了很多朋友。现在他不但身体健康了，{4}心情也好多了。他常说，这样的生活对老人很有{5}。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lóuxià yǒu yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng, jīnnián qīshí suì le. Yǐqián tā lǎoshì zài jiā kàn diànshì, hěn shǎo chūmén. Qùnián tā nǚ'ér jiànyì tā duō huódòng, tā jiù kāishǐ měi tiān zǎoshàng qù gōngyuán sànbù. Duì tā lái shuō, yìkāishǐ měi tiān zǎoshàng chūmén shì hěn xīnkǔ de shì, kěshì tā yuè zǒu yuè yǒu jīngshén, xiànzài měi tiān néng zǒu yí ge xiǎoshí. Tā hái zài gōngyuán jiāo le hěn duō péngyǒu. Xiànzài tā búdàn shēntǐ jiànkāng le, érqiě xīnqíng yě hǎo duō le. Tā cháng shuō, zhèyàng de shēnghuó duì lǎorén hěn yǒu hǎochù.
passage.english: An old gentleman lives downstairs from us; he is seventy this year. He used to sit at home watching TV all the time and seldom went out. Last year his daughter advised him to move about more, so he started walking in the park every morning. For him, going out every morning was hard at first, but the more he walked, the more energy he had, and now he can walk for an hour every day. He has also made many friends in the park. Now he is not only healthier but also in a much better mood. He often says this kind of life is good for old people.

questions.why: 以前他老是在家看電視: he always used to stay home watching TV. 從小 would need 就, 到底 belongs in a question, and 繼續 needs something already going on.
對他來說: from his point of view, going out every morning was hard at first. 來說 goes only with 對, not with 跟, 給 or 把.

focus.en: for …; as far as … is concerned

questions.why: 越走越有精神: the more he walks, the more energy he has. 越 … 越 come as a pair, so 更, 還 and 很 can't answer the first 越.
不但身體健康了，而且心情也好多了: 而且 adds the second gain to 不但. 所以, 然後 and 或是 don't pair with 不但.
這樣的生活對老人很有好處: this kind of life is good for old people (對……有好處). A way of life can't 有興趣 or 有精神 for someone, and 有情況 makes no sense here.

text.traditional: 我在一家公司上班。去年老闆發現，很多同事中午吃完飯就一直坐在電腦前面，下午都沒什麼精神，工作也做得很慢。為了改善這個情況，老闆在公司裡開了一間小健身房，還請了一位教練，每個星期一、三、五中午教大家運動半個小時。一開始很多人覺得麻煩，不想參加；可是運動了一個月以後，大家發現下午不但比較有精神，而且工作也做得比較快了。對我來說，最大的好處是背和脖子都不痛了。現在我差不多每天中午都去健身房，有時候也跟同事去公司附近的公園慢跑。
text.simplified: 我在一家公司上班。去年老板发现，很多同事中午吃完饭就一直坐在电脑前面，下午都没什么精神，工作也做得很慢。为了改善这个情况，老板在公司里开了一间小健身房，还请了一位教练，每个星期一、三、五中午教大家运动半个小时。一开始很多人觉得麻烦，不想参加；可是运动了一个月以后，大家发现下午不但比较有精神，而且工作也做得比较快了。对我来说，最大的好处是背和脖子都不痛了。现在我差不多每天中午都去健身房，有时候也跟同事去公司附近的公园慢跑。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài yì jiā gōngsī shàngbān. Qùnián lǎobǎn fāxiàn, hěn duō tóngshì zhōngwǔ chī wán fàn jiù yìzhí zuò zài diànnǎo qiánmiàn, xiàwǔ dōu méi shénme jīngshén, gōngzuò yě zuò de hěn màn. Wèile gǎishàn zhège qíngkuàng, lǎobǎn zài gōngsī lǐ kāi le yì jiān xiǎo jiànshēnfáng, hái qǐng le yí wèi jiàoliàn, měi ge xīngqíyī, sān, wǔ zhōngwǔ jiāo dàjiā yùndòng bàn ge xiǎoshí. Yìkāishǐ hěn duō rén juéde máfán, bù xiǎng cānjiā; kěshì yùndòng le yí ge yuè yǐhòu, dàjiā fāxiàn xiàwǔ búdàn bǐjiào yǒu jīngshén, érqiě gōngzuò yě zuò de bǐjiào kuài le. Duì wǒ lái shuō, zuì dà de hǎochù shì bèi hé bózi dōu bú tòng le. Xiànzài wǒ chàbùduō měi tiān zhōngwǔ dōu qù jiànshēnfáng, yǒu shíhòu yě gēn tóngshì qù gōngsī fùjìn de gōngyuán mànpǎo.
text.english: I work at a company. Last year the boss noticed that many of my coworkers sat at their computers all the time after lunch, had little energy in the afternoon and worked slowly. To improve this, the boss opened a small gym in the company and hired a coach, who teaches everyone a half-hour workout at noon every Monday, Wednesday and Friday. At first many people found it a bother and didn't want to take part; but after a month of exercise, everyone found they not only had more energy in the afternoon but also worked faster. For me, the biggest benefit is that my back and neck no longer hurt. Now I go to the gym at noon almost every day, and sometimes I jog in the park near the company with coworkers.

text.traditional: 我兒子今年十歲。以前他一回家就坐在沙發上玩手機，週末也不想出門，跟我們說的話越來越少。對他來說，運動是最無聊的事。去年夏天，我們決定每個星期六早上一家人一起去附近的學校打籃球。一開始他常常說不想去，可是後來他越打越喜歡，現在每個星期六都是他叫我們起床。打完球，我們常常一起去吃早飯，一邊吃一邊聊天。我發現，他不但身體越來越好，跟我們說的話也比以前多了。
text.simplified: 我儿子今年十岁。以前他一回家就坐在沙发上玩手机，周末也不想出门，跟我们说的话越来越少。对他来说，运动是最无聊的事。去年夏天，我们决定每个星期六早上一家人一起去附近的学校打篮球。一开始他常常说不想去，可是后来他越打越喜欢，现在每个星期六都是他叫我们起床。打完球，我们常常一起去吃早饭，一边吃一边聊天。我发现，他不但身体越来越好，跟我们说的话也比以前多了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ érzi jīnnián shí suì. Yǐqián tā yì huí jiā jiù zuò zài shāfā shàng wán shǒujī, zhōumò yě bù xiǎng chūmén, gēn wǒmen shuō de huà yuè lái yuè shǎo. Duì tā lái shuō, yùndòng shì zuì wúliáo de shì. Qùnián xiàtiān, wǒmen juédìng měi ge xīngqíliù zǎoshàng yì jiā rén yìqǐ qù fùjìn de xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú. Yìkāishǐ tā chángcháng shuō bù xiǎng qù, kěshì hòulái tā yuè dǎ yuè xǐhuān, xiànzài měi ge xīngqíliù dōu shì tā jiào wǒmen qǐchuáng. Dǎ wán qiú, wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī zǎofàn, yìbiān chī yìbiān liáotiān. Wǒ fāxiàn, tā búdàn shēntǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo, gēn wǒmen shuō de huà yě bǐ yǐqián duō le.
text.english: My son is ten. He used to sit on the sofa playing on his phone as soon as he got home, didn't want to go out at weekends, and talked with us less and less. To him, exercise was the most boring thing there was. Last summer we decided that every Saturday morning the whole family would play basketball at a school nearby. At first he often said he didn't want to go, but later, the more he played, the more he liked it, and now he is the one who wakes us up every Saturday. After the game we often go for breakfast together, eating and chatting. I've found that he is not only getting healthier, but also talks with us more than before.

text.traditional: 上個週末，我的兩個日本朋友來台灣玩。為了讓他們了解台灣的夜市文化，我帶他們去逛夜市。那天晚上人多得不得了，我們擠了半天才走到賣臭豆腐的地方。我推薦他們吃吃看，可是一個朋友聞到味道就不敢吃了，只好買了一碗芒果冰。還有一個朋友吃了一點以後，覺得越吃越香，一個人吃完了一大盤。後來他想買一件毛衣，老闆說一件八百塊，我幫他跟老闆殺價，最後六百塊就買到了。回去的時候，他們都說吃得太飽了，明天還想再來。
text.simplified: 上个周末，我的两个日本朋友来台湾玩。为了让他们了解台湾的夜市文化，我带他们去逛夜市。那天晚上人多得不得了，我们挤了半天才走到卖臭豆腐的地方。我推荐他们吃吃看，可是一个朋友闻到味道就不敢吃了，只好买了一碗芒果冰。还有一个朋友吃了一点以后，觉得越吃越香，一个人吃完了一大盘。后来他想买一件毛衣，老板说一件八百块，我帮他跟老板杀价，最后六百块就买到了。回去的时候，他们都说吃得太饱了，明天还想再来。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ de liǎng ge Rìběn péngyǒu lái Táiwān wán. Wèile ràng tāmen liǎojiě Táiwān de yèshì wénhuà, wǒ dài tāmen qù guàng yèshì. Nà tiān wǎnshàng rén duō de bùdéliǎo, wǒmen jǐ le bàntiān cái zǒu dào mài chòudòufǔ de dìfāng. Wǒ tuījiàn tāmen chīchī kàn, kěshì yí ge péngyǒu wén dào wèidào jiù bù gǎn chī le, zhǐhǎo mǎi le yì wǎn mángguǒbīng. Hái yǒu yí ge péngyǒu chī le yìdiǎn yǐhòu, juéde yuè chī yuè xiāng, yí ge rén chī wán le yí dà pán. Hòulái tā xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn máoyī, lǎobǎn shuō yí jiàn bābǎi kuài, wǒ bāng tā gēn lǎobǎn shājià, zuìhòu liùbǎi kuài jiù mǎi dào le. Huíqù de shíhòu, tāmen dōu shuō chī de tài bǎo le, míngtiān hái xiǎng zài lái.
text.english: Last weekend two Japanese friends of mine came to Taiwan on holiday. To show them Taiwan's night-market culture, I took them to a night market. It was incredibly crowded that evening, and it took us ages to squeeze our way to the stinky tofu stall. I told them to try it, but one friend didn't dare eat it once he smelled it, so he had to buy a bowl of mango ice instead. My other friend had a little, found it tastier with every bite and finished a big plate by himself. Later he wanted a sweater; the owner said NT$800, I haggled with the owner for him, and in the end he got it for 600. On the way back they both said they were too full, and that they wanted to come back tomorrow.

prompt.english: What did the writer do when the friend bought the sweater?

choices.english: Helped the friend choose a colour.
Recommended the sweater to the friend.

questions.why: 我幫他跟老闆殺價: the writer haggled the price down from 800 to 600 (殺價 = 講價). The writer recommended the stinky tofu, not the sweater, and says nothing about paying or colours.

text.traditional: 我跟室友一起租了一間公寓，房租每個月一萬兩千塊，我們一個人付一半。我們說好了，每個星期六一起打掃：我負責掃地、倒垃圾，她負責擦桌子、洗碗。可是我的室友總是很晚才起床，常常到了中午還沒把碗洗完，廚房裡到處都是髒碗筷。上個星期六，房東來收房租，看到廚房那麼亂，非常不高興。後來我們決定，誰先把自己的家事做完，誰就可以決定晚上看什麼電影。現在我的室友每個星期六都很早就起床了。
text.simplified: 我跟室友一起租了一间公寓，房租每个月一万两千块，我们一个人付一半。我们说好了，每个星期六一起打扫：我负责扫地、倒垃圾，她负责擦桌子、洗碗。可是我的室友总是很晚才起床，常常到了中午还没把碗洗完，厨房里到处都是脏碗筷。上个星期六，房东来收房租，看到厨房那么乱，非常不高兴。后来我们决定，谁先把自己的家事做完，谁就可以决定晚上看什么电影。现在我的室友每个星期六都很早就起床了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu yìqǐ zū le yì jiān gōngyù, fángzū měi ge yuè yíwàn liǎngqiān kuài, wǒmen yí ge rén fù yíbàn. Wǒmen shuō hǎo le, měi ge xīngqíliù yìqǐ dǎsǎo: wǒ fùzé sǎodì, dào lèsè, tā fùzé cā zhuōzi, xǐ wǎn. Kěshì wǒ de shìyǒu zǒngshì hěn wǎn cái qǐchuáng, chángcháng dào le zhōngwǔ hái méi bǎ wǎn xǐ wán, chúfáng lǐ dàochù dōu shì zāng wǎnkuài. Shàng ge xīngqíliù, fángdōng lái shōu fángzū, kàn dào chúfáng nàme luàn, fēicháng bù gāoxìng. Hòulái wǒmen juédìng, shéi xiān bǎ zìjǐ de jiāshì zuò wán, shéi jiù kěyǐ juédìng wǎnshàng kàn shénme diànyǐng. Xiànzài wǒ de shìyǒu měi ge xīngqíliù dōu hěn zǎo jiù qǐchuáng le.
text.english: My roommate and I rent an apartment together. The rent is NT$12,000 a month, and we each pay half. We agreed to clean together every Saturday: I sweep the floor and take out the trash, and she wipes the tables and washes the dishes. But my roommate always gets up very late, often hasn't finished the dishes by noon, and dirty dishes are everywhere in the kitchen. Last Saturday the landlord came to collect the rent, saw the messy kitchen and was very unhappy. Later we decided that whoever finishes her own chores first gets to decide which movie we watch that evening. Now my roommate gets up early every Saturday.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人每個月要付多少房租？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人每个月要付多少房租？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén měi ge yuè yào fù duōshǎo fángzū?
prompt.english: How much rent does the writer pay each month?

questions.why: The rent is 12,000 a month and 我們一個人付一半: each pays half, 6,000. 12,000 is the whole rent, not the writer's share.

prompt.traditional: 房東為什麼生氣？
prompt.simplified: 房东为什么生气？
prompt.pinyin: Fángdōng wèishénme shēngqì?
prompt.english: Why was the landlord angry?

choices.english: The living room was dirty and messy.
It was too noisy at night.
The kitchen was dirty and messy.
The trash hadn't been taken out.

questions.why: 看到廚房那麼亂，非常不高興: he saw the kitchen full of dirty dishes. The living room, noise and the trash are never mentioned.

prompt.traditional: 後來兩個人決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 后来两个人决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Hòulái liǎng ge rén juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What did the two of them decide?

choices.traditional: 兩個人換一下負責的家事
choices.simplified: 两个人换一下负责的家事
choices.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén huàn yíxià fùzé de jiāshì.

choices.traditional: 先做完家事的人選電影
choices.simplified: 先做完家事的人选电影
choices.pinyin: Xiān zuò wán jiāshì de rén xuǎn diànyǐng.
choices.english: Whoever finishes the chores first picks the movie.

choices.pinyin: Wǎn qǐchuáng de rén yào qǐngkè.
choices.english: Whoever gets up late pays for a treat.

choices.pinyin: Zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn yǐqián dǎsǎo wán.

questions.why: 誰先把自己的家事做完，誰就可以決定晚上看什麼電影: whoever finishes her chores first picks the evening's movie. They don't swap chores, and there is no treat for getting up late and no deadline.
